success.assertion: test('4922/1016完整红严格小于300授下两次增伤50%并实际消费，300边界不授',()=>{for(const amount of[299,300]){const s=make({...row(1016),loadout:[10001,29393,29394,33592,38459]}),z=make({...row(1016),index:-1,loadout:[10001,29393,29394,33592,38459]});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0)c.minimumDamage=amount;},()=>{turn(s,38459,20117);turn(z,38459,20117);});assert.equal(sum(s),amount);for(let r=2;r<=4;r++){turn(s,10001,20117);turn(z,10001,20117);const mult=amount===299&&r<=3?1.5:1;assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s)-sum(z)*mult)<=1);}}});
